summary: Window 24h messaging feature testing completed. Backend: 10/11 tests passed (91%). Frontend: All window features working correctly including badge display, expired window bar, template modal, and i18n translations.

minor.issue: Returns 500 instead of 404 when conversation_id doesn't exist. The .single() Supabase call throws an exception instead of returning None.

backend: GET /api/window/status/{conversation_id} - Returns all required fields (window_active, window_expires_at, seconds_remaining, hours_remaining, minutes_remaining, last_customer_message_at)
GET /api/templates - Returns list of templates with id, name, languages, variables
POST /api/templates/send/{conversation_id} - Successfully sends template and saves message in messages table
GET /api/conversations - Includes window object with window_active and seconds_remaining
GET /api/conversations/{id} - Includes window object with full status
frontend: Conversation list shows window indicator badges (green for active, red for expired)
Window badge in chat header shows countdown (e.g., '20h 09m') for active windows
Window badge shows 'Finestra tancada' (CA) / 'Ventana cerrada' (ES) / 'Window closed' (EN) for expired
Active window: Message input and attach button visible
Expired window: Warning bar visible with 'Finestra de 24h expirada' message
Expired window: 'Enviar plantilla' button visible in warning bar
Template modal opens with template selector dropdown
Template modal shows customer name input field (pre-filled with contact name)
Template modal shows preview of template with variables replaced
Template modal shows cost warning 'Aquest missatge tindrà cost'
i18n CA: 'Finestra tancada', 'Finestra de 24h expirada', 'Enviar plantilla'
i18n ES: 'Ventana cerrada', 'Ventana de 24h expirada', 'Enviar plantilla'
i18n EN: 'Window closed', '24h window expired', 'Send template'

action_items: Minor: Fix POST /api/templates/send/{conversation_id} to return 404 instead of 500 for non-existent conversation (use .maybe_single() or handle exception)
seed_data_creation: Template message sent during testing to Botiga conversation (visible in messages)

mocked_apis.note: All APIs use real Supabase database. WhatsApp template API may fail (template not approved in Meta) but fallback to text message works.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Window 24h feature fully tested. Active windows show green badge with countdown, expired windows show red badge and warning bar with template button. Template modal works correctly with preview and cost warning. i18n verified for CA/ES/EN. One minor backend issue: POST /api/templates/send returns 500 instead of 404 for non-existent conversation.
